reviews.title: Stupid App

⭐️ 1 Star

I have thousands of questions and things I want to check, and many times I simply close your app and go to another company because their apps are much easier and faster to use.

At this point, I only use your app when I’m already nearby and need something immediately. Otherwise, I’d rather use a competitor.

I honestly don’t understand who designed this experience or why anyone thought it was a good idea. You are losing customers simply because the app is so inconvenient.

This is actually my first negative app review, but this experience deserves 1 star. If other customers feel the same way, please like this review or leave your own feedback so the company finally pays attention and improves the app.

reviews.title: Uhaul refused 2nd form of payment and stole loaded truck
reviews.text:
So to start, the initial contract was three days, around August 3. We had to keep extending it, because we are elderly people. Then there was a problem that they refused a second form of payment to keep extending the truck. My 79 year old mom has cancer and dementia, deaf too. 

Uhaul corporate information claimed that we had not contacted them in 10 days, which wasn’t true at all. We made contact on Saturday and Wednesday. Yet while my mom was talking to them, around 4 PM Wednesday, they were stealing the truck and cutting the chains on my trailer down to 2 inches. 

So here we are at a new location where they have delivered the truck and told us elderly people that we had 72 hours to remove our things from the truck that took us 3 weeks to pack and the truck will not start and the tires have been deflated. 

We were told by our original, Uhaul managerThat we would be able to pay off the first contract and re-rent the very same truck.Instead they are treating us like criminals as if they don’t recall that I’ve rented more than $10,000 worth of trucks since December 3, 2024 when I was wrongfully evicted from my inheritance byAttorneys hired by the Catholic Church.

Our original U-Haul manager was a God-sent earth angel/Saint who helped us out multiple times over the last year and a half that we’ve been stuck out in this almost homeless position.

.Unfortunately, Uhaul has decided to demote him because supposedly he wasn’t making enough money for them?

reviews.title: Location services do not work, you will be charged extra for a self return
reviews.text:
Horrible app, just the website but slower.
Location services do not work. I tried on both iOS and Android, in the app and in the browser on both, with location services enabled for each program in each OS.
I self returned a truck and it was never able to get my location so I wasn’t able to submit photos to verify I dropped the truck off.
I took photos anyway (of myself in front of the sign with the license plate in view) and sent them to their support. They were kind but useless.
The return has to be processed manually the next day which charges an extra fee. There was nothing I could do, and the things I did do to try and cover myself for their webapp’s failure were useless to their support team, so I am being charged.
Don’t use U-Haul. They require you to get the app and it is broken.

reviews.title: App failed at the only two things I needed it to do
reviews.text:
installed the U-Haul app for one reason: to get propane from the West Seattle location.

The app showed 322 gallons of propane available, so I drove there. Once I arrived, I used the app’s “request service” feature, since the location no longer has the doorbell they used to use. I waited several minutes. Nothing happened. I requested service again. Still nothing.

Eventually I went inside, where an employee told me they were out of propane for the day.

So the app failed on both things that mattered: it told me propane was available when it wasn’t, and its service-request feature failed to get anyone to come outside.

The app itself was easy enough to use. Unfortunately, it just made it very efficient to get completely inaccurate information and no service.

reviews.title: Number one worst experience with a company literally ever, I WISH I was exaggerating
reviews.text:
The app didn’t work for the 24/7 truck share, so I called support. BIG mistake, HUGE. DO NOT CALL SUPPORT, not only will they not help you but they will actively work to make your life harder. The chat support people tried to help, unlike the people you get if you call, but it was such a MESS that even they couldn’t help much. I spent HOURS at my pickup location (which wasn’t my preferred one, btw, they let you pick when you make the reservation, as if that means anything, and then they send you wherever they please to actually pick it up), six different calls with support, and five different chats with more support people. I wish I could spread the word to everyone I know: if you have literally ANY option other than a U-Haul, please take the other option. I will literally never use U-Haul again. I will go out and BUY MY OWN box truck before I use this company again. I will tell my future children, grandchildren, and great grandchildren to never even get within 50 feet of anything associated with this WRETCHED COMPANY. I truly cannot say enough bad things about U-Haul. 

This app doesn’t do the one thing you’re downloading it for, but it does track you CONSTANTLY the minute you download it on your phone. I wish I could delete it and wipe this company from my conscious memory, but I have to wait until I return the truck…

reviews.title: Impossible to delete account. So 1-star it is.
reviews.text:
U-Haul provides a mechanism to delete your account. It appears as though it works. You click the button and confirm the deletion and you’re logged out. Most people would happily move on and forget about it. I didn’t. I tried logging back in. I was immediately allowed back in. All of my personal data remains visible in the account. This is fraud, as far as I’m concerned, and they should be reported to regulatory bodies for it. 

Apple, once again, your app review team is failing to catch massive issues. Do better.

Edit: I had a chat with a U-Haul support agent who was utterly useless. She insisted that I can delete my account via a web browser. I insisted that I’ve tried that with no success. I asked her to delete my account. She claimed she did. Then I attempted to log in and of course I could. My data is still there. U-Haul are either dangerously inept or have ulterior motives. Either way, I’m reporting them to regulatory bodies for violations of state privacy laws.

reviews.title: V3.9.7p is terrible
reviews.text:
You know what’s really frustrating? Having to enter all the information over and over again. All I wanted to do was check and ‘see’ what size trailers U-Haul offers. Nope. I must enter all the information like where I want to pick it up and when and what kind of vehicle I will be pulling it with. Keep in mind that I am just ‘checking’ and not wanting to make a reservation. I want to know what you offer and I can decide later what I need, when I need it and how to pull it. Your app does not do that! 
And to make matters worse, and pay attention here — when I view a trailer by pressing the select button and then press the < to go back to the list — NOPE!! It starts at the beginning wanting me to select location, date, vehicle… etc. I even logged in and tried to see if it was just me doing something wrong. Nope, it’s this app. Very poor design. And this review is the only feedback process available. Also dumb as it now is publicly reflected.
